items.title: Capital One says Trump Organization accounts closed after AML review
items.summary: Investing.com -- Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) said it closed more than 300 Trump Organization-affiliated accounts after a months-long review by its anti-money laundering team, according to a court filing reported by Reuters.
